description: This Java class implements a clustered version control service for Thingsboard, handling repository operations, message processing, and event-driven updates within a distributed environment.

classes.name: DefaultClusterVersionControlService
classes.description: Implements a distributed version control service with message processing, repository management, and event handling for Thingsboard.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes message consumers, thread pools, and producer for version control processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down message consumers, thread pools, and executor services.

methods.name: onTbApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles partition change events to clean up repositories and update subscriptions.

methods.name: filterTbApplicationEvent
methods.description: Filters events to process only those related to version control executor service.

methods.name: afterStartUp
methods.description: Launches message consumer after startup.

methods.name: processMsgs
methods.description: Processes batch of incoming messages, dispatching tasks to thread pools.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Processes individual message based on its type, handling repository commands and version control operations.

methods.name: handleEntitiesContentRequest
methods.description: Handles request to retrieve content of multiple entities at a specific version.

methods.name: handleEntityContentRequest
methods.description: Handles request to retrieve content of a single entity at a specific version.

methods.name: handleListVersions
methods.description: Handles request to list versions of an entity or branch.

methods.name: handleListEntities
methods.description: Handles request to list entities at a specific version.

methods.name: handleListBranches
methods.description: Handles request to list branches.

methods.name: handleVersionsDiffRequest
methods.description: Handles request to get differences between two versions.

methods.name: handleCommitRequest
methods.description: Handles commit-related requests including prepare, add, delete, push, and abort.

methods.name: prepareCommit
methods.description: Prepares a commit with metadata and manages pending commit state.

methods.name: deleteFromCommit
methods.description: Deletes folder content in a commit.

methods.name: addToCommit
methods.description: Adds entity data to a commit, handling chunked data.

methods.name: doAbortCurrentCommit
methods.description: Aborts the current pending commit.

methods.name: handleClearRepositoryCommand
methods.description: Clears the repository for a tenant.

methods.name: handleInitRepositoryCommand
methods.description: Initializes a repository for a tenant.

methods.name: handleTestRepositoryCommand
methods.description: Tests repository connectivity and configuration.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles exceptions, especially LargeObjectException.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Sends response messages back to the requester, with optional enrichment or error info.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Constructs relative file path for entities based on type and ID.

methods.name: getRepoLock
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a lock for tenant repository synchronization.

methods.name: logTaskExecution
methods.description: Logs execution time and success/failure of message processing tasks.
